findings.current: The estimated death toll alone had already reached fifty million.
findings.defect: 사상자 counts the dead and injured, not deaths alone.
findings.rationale: The draft changes the scale of confirmed deaths.
findings.replacement: Estimates already put the number of dead and injured at fifty million.

findings.current: “A million people died the day we fought it. A thousand Hunters, led by no fewer than four S-ranks, died as well.”
findings.defect: 인명 피해 means casualties, not deaths; “we fought it” also places Furin among the combatants without source support.
findings.rationale: The source gives a casualty figure for the battle and does not identify Furin as a participant.
findings.replacement: “The day of the battle against it, there were a million casualties. A thousand Hunters led by no fewer than four S-ranks died as well.”
findings.source: 놈과의 전투가 있던 날, 백만에 달하는 인명 피해가 있었지. 무려 네 명의 S급이 지휘하던 천 명의 헌터들도 함께 죽었고.

findings.current: “Then you—you came from the other world you mentioned?”
findings.defect: Furin corrects his address from familiar 너 to more respectful 당신; repeating “you” loses the deliberate adjustment.
findings.rationale: The correction marks Furin’s attempt to address Morgoth more respectfully as he sees a chance to negotiate.
findings.replacement: “Then you—no, sir. Did you come from the other world you mentioned?”
findings.source: “그렇다면 너, 아니 당신은 지금 말한 그 이계에서 온 건가?”

findings.current: There had been several major incidents over the past year, beginning with the appearance of the Lich. But compared with what had happened over the last ten days, they were a drop in the bucket.
findings.defect: 아크 리치 loses its Arch designation.
findings.rationale: The source names the Arch Lich and dates its appearance to approximately a year earlier.
findings.replacement: There had been several major incidents since the Arch Lich appeared about a year ago. But compared with what had happened over the last ten days, they were a drop in the bucket.
findings.source: 약 일 년 전, 아크 리치의 출현을 시작으로 여러 대사건이 있었지만, 지난 열흘간 벌어진 일들에 비하면 새 발의 피에 불과했다.

findings.current: Furin took a long draw on his cigar, its tip glowing evenly, then added:
findings.defect: The draft adds a long draw where the source says Furin evenly lit the tip and put the cigar in his mouth.
findings.rationale: The source describes lighting and positioning the cigar, not inhaling from it.
findings.replacement: Furin put the cigar, its tip now evenly lit, between his lips and added:
findings.source: 끝부분을 골고루 태운 푸린이 시가를 물며 덧붙였다.

summary: Two casualty figures are rendered as deaths, and Furin’s shift to respectful address is lost.
